top_signals.title: Citadel's Ubide Expects Treasury Yields to 'Stabilize'
top_signals.summary: Angel Ubide, Citadel's head of economic research for fixed income and macro, discusses the outlook for Federal Reserve policy, Treasuries and the spread between French and Italian bond yields. Ubide talks with Francine Lacqua in Cernobbio, Italy. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Research: UK official holdings of international reserves: August 2026
top_signals.summary: This release details movements in the international reserves of gold and assets held by the UK government.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Record Cash Freezes India’s Key Funding Market for 90 Minutes
top_signals.summary: A record cash surplus in India’s banking system is driving away borrowers.

top_signals.title: Commission adopts EU Guidelines on exclusionary abuses of dominance
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 03 Sep 2026 The European Commission has today adopted Guidelines on the application of Article 102 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union ('TFEU') to abusive exclusionary conduct by dominant companies. The adoption of the guidelines marks the end of a three-year process in which the Commission consulted extensively with stakeholders.

top_signals.title: Eight petroleum liquids pipeline projects have been completed since the start of 2025
top_signals.summary: In the 2026 release of our Liquids Pipeline Projects Database, we tracked the completion of 8 liquid fuels pipeline projects since the start of 2025, and an additional 14 new projects have been announced.
